hookA.script: Saenchai fought bigger men his whole career. Here's how he thought about it.

hookB.script: If you always spar someone bigger than you, steal this from Saenchai.

hookC.script: Bigger guys win the trade. Saenchai never traded.

heavier.script: Saenchai spent most of his career fighting heavier men. Often by several kilos, because nobody his size could beat him.

muscle.script: He didn't try to out-muscle them. He never stood in front of them long enough to trade.

step.script: He'd step off the line. Catch the kick. Sweep them. And make them start over.

reset.script: Every reset costs the bigger guy energy, and a little confidence. Do that ten times, and he's the one getting frustrated.

win.script: So next time you spar someone bigger, don't try to win the exchange. Win the reset.

cta.script: Save this for your next spar. And send it to the smallest guy in your gym.

loopA.script: So next time someone tells you size wins, remember.
